About

She works in mood.

Sallie Townsend has been directing since before she had a name for it — she volunteered herself as the first “director” of her elementary school programs, and found a lasting love for leading others to perform.

During three years with Grace Blu Interiors she styled the campaign and co-directed the shoot with photographer Douglas Friedman, then pitched the images that landed the studio in Architectural Digest Middle East — their first major press placement. She has since directed visual storytelling and brand work for The Girl at the Garden Gate, Après Cowgirl, and Spoak.com.

Now, through her studio EatUrMood, she builds brand worlds around one quiet idea: every brand has a mood, and it’s worth telling well.
